label: Late-episode GO: strongest after a rewarded a1->S1 trial and when S1 is believed good; weaker after no reward.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 75) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 75) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 75) * (prev_reward == 0)
terms: (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 70) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 70) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 70) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 70) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 70) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 60) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 60) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 80) * last_is("a1 S1 r")
explanation: Fires only at GO, late in the episode (timing baseline ramps up from trial ~60). Beyond timing, its magnitude grows after a rewarded a1->S1 common trial, grows with the observer log-odds that S1 is good, and drops after an unrewarded trial (late-episode a1/S1-reward-streak signal; peaks ~1.1 during long a1-S1-rewarded runs). Nothing at D1 or D2. The episode gate threshold matters a lot (>=60 gives 0.38 dev, >=75 gives 0.55). The free fit adds a reward-on-a1 two trials back term and a prev_action term (which mostly offsets), plus a mix of gate thresholds; it under-predicts the peak in long streaks. Only observed variables used.

issues: The scores reproduce. On test the short form scores 0.534 beyond timing. Dropping the prev_reward==0 term gives 0.424, and last_is('a1 S1 r') alone gives 0.369. Cutoffs: >=80 gives 0.531, >=70 gives 0.486.

Large systematic under-prediction at the peaks. In every worst-fit window the agent is on a late (t85-97) run of rewarded a1->S1 trials: actual is about 1.05-1.14, but predicted levels off at about 0.60-0.63. The model gets roughly 55% of the peak. The explanation admits this, but it is the main mass of the feature and no short-form variant fixes it. Variants tried: belief instead of belief_lo (0.486), max(belief_lo,0) (0.491), ep_trial-graded last_is (0.475), and an added >=85 last_is term (0.451).

Window-start error. On the first trial of a window last_is is unknown ('?'), so a strong GO activation (about 1.07) is predicted at only about 0.19. Every worst window shows this at position -3. This is a limit of the data, not a fact about the feature, but it is systematic.

The feature is not specific to S1: after a rewarded rare a1->S2 trial it still fires at about 0.97 (under-predicted, +0.015). It also persists at about 0.4-0.6 on the next GO when the agent then picks a2. So 'after a rewarded a1 choice' fits better than 'after a rewarded a1->S1 trial', but the short-form factor limits block a state-free 'a1 rewarded' term.
Over-predicted after a2 S1 r (-0.044) and a1 S2 u (-0.031). belief_lo pushes the prediction up when S1 is believed good, even when the last trial argues against an a1 streak.

The prev_reward==0 term partly works as a correction for the late-GO cutoff. Replacing it with a plain (phase==GO)*(ep_trial>=75) indicator already gives 0.486 of the 0.534. Its real contribution ('weaker after no reward') is about +0.05 R^2. That supports the claim directionally, but the term is partly fitted structure rather than pure description.

The label is broadly faithful (GO only, late episode, a1->S1 rewarded, S1 believed good, lower after no reward). It does not say that activation is 0 at D1/D2 and essentially 0 right after an unrewarded trial.
skeptic.revised_label: Late-episode (trial ~75+) GO only: grows through runs of rewarded a1 trials while S1 is believed good; off after no reward.
